signals.title: Europese Commissie wil MiCA uitbreiden voor tokenisering en niet-EU stablecoin-emittenten
signals.summary: The European Commission is reportedly seeking comment from stakeholders on expanding MiCA rules until Sept. 30.

signals.title: Base-oprichter Pollak voorspelt groei tokenisering aandelen en niet-dollar stablecoins
signals.summary: Coinbase launched tokenized stocks on Base six weeks ago, with about $70 million to $100 million in daily volume, according to Pollak.

signals.title: XRP Ledger voegt controles toe voor banken, stablecoins en getokeniseerde fondsen
signals.summary: XRP Ledger adds new controls for banks, stablecoins and tokenized funds

signals.title: EBA-dashboard toont banken boven Basel III-minimumvereisten in Q2 2026
signals.summary: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published its CRR3/CRD6 dashboard as of Q2 2026 for 129 banks at the highest level of consolidation across the EU/EEA. EU/EEA banks maintain capital levels well above minimum requirements under the fully loaded CRR3 framework, with an average Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) ratio projected at 15.1%, despite an increased impact of the output floor compared with previous editions.

signals.title: ECB en EU centrale banken willen MiCA-depositorequirements voor stablecoins aanpassen
signals.summary: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

signals.title: EBA publiceert ontwerpmethodologie voor boeterollen onder MiCA
signals.summary: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today a Consultation Paper with a draft methodology for setting fines in its role as supervisor under MiCA. The objective is to ensure that fines imposed on issuers of significant crypto-assets are consistent, proportionate and transparent, and effectively support compliance with the regulatory framework.

signals.title: ECB lanceert Pontes voor afwikkeling van gettokeniseerde activa zonder stablecoins
signals.summary: Pontes will expand its services and operating hours gradually, with full implementation expected by 2028 and more participants set to join.

signals.title: VS en VK herbevestigen steun voor stablecoins en tokenisering in regelgeving
signals.summary: In a July 8 meeting, US and UK regulators highlighted the implementation of the GENIUS Act, payment modernization and cross-border cooperation, reinforcing a shared framework for digital asset oversight.
